front.intro: This East End bungalow was updated from the foundation up, so the big-ticket work is already done. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced, and the wiring, breaker box and plumbing are all new. Three-phase power is already in place. Inside, new floors, trim, paint and lighting run from the Living Room through the Dining area to an open Kitchen. A pantry and a Breakfast Nook sit just behind the Kitchen. Out back, a fenced yard gives you room to park or to entertain. Interior laundry and a new driveway round out the list.
front.outro: A new driveway runs down the side of the lot to the covered garage at the back. The covered patio sits alongside it, open to the fenced yard. A small deck with steps leads out from the Breakfast Nook door. Heavy wood posts hold up a solid roof over a concrete floor, with a wood plank wall at the back. The covered garage has heavy wood posts, a solid roof and a concrete floor.

top.title: Living, Kitchen, Dining and the plan

big.name: Living Room
big.text: The front door opens straight into the Living Room, which has a tall double-pane window and a long clerestory window set high on the wall for light with privacy. Wood-look flooring runs through every main room with no thresholds, and there is no carpet in the living areas. All new electrical, lighting and plumbing fixtures were installed throughout.

small.name: Kitchen
small.text: The Kitchen is all new, set up in an L with a peninsula, dark navy lower cabinets and white shaker-style uppers. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, and the sink is under a window. The pantry (4'7" x 3'4") is a few steps away.

small.name: Dining Area
small.text: A modern sputnik-style fixture hangs over the Dining area, which sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. The Breakfast Nook and the pantry open off the back of the Kitchen. New flooring, paint and lighting carry through.

top.planNote: The front porch and the Living Room are at the bottom of the plan. The Primary Bedroom is at the back of the house, beside its bath. The hall to the bedrooms starts at the Dining area. Bedroom 2 is at the front corner.

bottom.title: A private Primary and two more bedrooms

big.name: Primary Bedroom
big.text: Set at the rear of the house, away from the street, the Primary has the only vaulted ceiling in the home, with an exposed painted beam running the length of the room. A window looks out to mature trees. There is room for a king bed, nightstands and a dresser. New trim and paint finish the room, with new carpet underfoot. The Primary Bath, with double sinks and a walk-in shower, is steps away. The room measures 14'4" x 14'6" on the listing's floor plan, next to the covered garage.

tall.name: Primary Bath
tall.text: Double sinks sit in a marble-look top on a dark navy vanity. An LED backlit mirror stretches nearly the full width above it. Brushed-finish faucets match the shower fixtures, and the walk-in shower finishes the room.

tall.name: Hall Bath
tall.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this all new bath, which also serves as the guest bath. A wide integrated sink and a brushed-finish faucet sit beneath a backlit mirror. Marble-look tile covers the walls around the tub.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower down the center, with hanging rods on both sides. More shelves above hold storage bins or luggage. The built-ins stay with the house. The Primary Bath is right beside it.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: Bedroom 2 sits at the front corner of the house, with windows on two walls that let natural light in from two directions. It has carpet, a closet and fresh paint and trim. The Living Room and the hall bath are steps away.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: A large window brings natural light into Bedroom 3, and a reach-in closet sits beside the door. Fresh paint, new trim and carpet complete the room. It sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary. The hall has wood-look flooring.

back.title: The yard and the breakfast spaces

outdoor.name: The front of the house
outdoor.text: A wide concrete walk leads to the covered porch and the Craftsman-style front door. Low-maintenance siding and board and batten detail dress the front of the house. The roof is new. Updated systems and a fenced yard come with the lot. EaDo is minutes away. Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road are under half a mile away.

outdoor.name: The yard and the covered garage
outdoor.text: The fenced yard holds a huge covered garage and outdoor entertaining space, next to an 8'11" x 25'11" patio. M.C. Cullinan Park is about 0.3 miles away, an easy walk. Open ground leaves room for a garden or outdoor seating. Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover a concrete floor, with a wood plank back wall. Mason Park is about 1.7 miles away.

details.name: Breakfast Bar
details.text: Two pendant lights hang over a stone-look counter with room for barstools. The peninsula gives you a serving spot on one side and prep space on the other. The Dining area sits right beside it. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook are around the corner at the back of the Kitchen.

details.name: Breakfast Nook
details.text: Windows on two walls and a door to the backyard make the Nook bright and easy to use. The Kitchen counters wrap right up to the Nook. A modern light fixture hangs over the center of the room for a casual table. The window brings steady natural light to the back of the Kitchen.

The Kitchen has navy lower cabinets, white shaker-style uppers and a stainless range, and the Primary Bedroom has the home's only vaulted ceiling, with a painted beam. Out back, a fenced yard holds a covered patio and a covered garage. Cullinan Park is about 0.3 miles away.

b.text: Come see a 1940 East End bungalow redone from the foundation up. The wiring, breaker box and plumbing are new, and so are the floors, the lighting and the roof. The Kitchen has navy lower cabinets, white shaker-style uppers and a stainless range, and the Primary Bedroom has the home's only vaulted ceiling, with a painted beam. Out back, a fenced yard holds a covered patio and a covered garage, and a new driveway runs down the side of the lot. Cullinan Park is about 0.3 miles away, and Bohemeo's is about 0.6 miles away. It has never flooded.
